name: legato
description: Give Claude a computer: a desktop container, this computer's screen, or a cloud desktop, that it can see and click.
long_description: Legato opens a desktop and lets Claude click, type and read the screen. Each action returns the new screenshot as soon as the screen has stopped changing. Choose where the desktop runs: a Linux container on this machine (needs Docker; Claude cannot touch your own screen), this computer's own screen (macOS and Windows: give Claude Desktop Screen Recording and Accessibility permission), or an E2B cloud desktop (needs an E2B API key). Open source, Apache-2.0: https://github.com/legatolabs/legato

tools.name: desktop_open
tools.description: Open a desktop and return its first screenshot

tools.name: desktop_act
tools.description: Click, type, press keys, scroll or drag; returns the settled screenshot

tools.name: desktop_run_task
tools.description: Hand a whole task to another model (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

sandbox.title: Where the desktop runs
sandbox.description: docker: a Linux container on this machine (needs Docker). local: this computer's screen. e2b: a cloud desktop (needs an E2B API key).
